claim_text: Hussein Mohamed Farah, USAO-MN's 73rd charged Feeding Our Future defendant (charged by information on August 6, 2025, No. 0:25-cr-00297, tied to the New Vision Foundation nonprofit), was reported by FOX 9 to have been sentenced on August 27, 2026 to 20 months in federal prison, two years of supervised release, and $471,000 in restitution for wire fraud.

supporting_passages.quote: Hussein Mohamed Farah was sentenced on 2026-08-27 to 20 months in federal prison, two years of supervised release, and $471,000 restitution for wire fraud.

amounts.methodology: Reported by FOX 9; no primary judgment, sentencing minute, or new USAO release has been captured confirming this figure.

qualifiers: No primary court record (judgment, sentencing minute) or USAO release specifically confirming this sentencing has been captured; corroborated only by the federal hearing calendar listing Farah for sentencing before Judge Nancy E. Brasel at 10:00 a.m. on 2026-08-27, and by USAO's prior 2025-08-06 charging release identifying Farah as the 73rd defendant and New Vision Foundation's $2.7 million figure.

USAO-MN's own August 27, 2026 release for the same week (src-usao-mn-2026-08-27-fof-three-sentences) describes Ahmed, Ghedi, and Omar-Hashim as the 24th-26th Feeding Our Future defendants sentenced and does not mention Farah. This is an apparent sequencing/ordinal discrepancy that is preserved here, not resolved: it is possible Farah was sentenced the same week under a separate press release not yet captured, or that the ordinal numbering tracks a different count than raw sentencing order. Do not assume either explanation.
Do not upgrade this claim to ADJUDICATED until a primary judgment, sentencing minute, or USAO release naming Farah specifically is captured.
editorial_notes: Third finding in the freshness/disposition-reconciliation pass prompted by the cluster of August 2026 USAO sentencing releases. Reconciles a status gap: defendants.json previously listed Farah as 'charged' despite this source already being captured in an earlier pass and never actioned.
